question: What bodily and perceptual attainments are associated with this wheel?
premises: One attainment is the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair.
Another attainment is seeing from very far away.
inference: This wheel grants the removal of wrinkles and grey hair and the ability to see from very far away.
plain_english: It brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the ability to see from very far away.
